{{Quote|Little did we realize that it was a trap when the building was attacked by 30 stormtroopers. We did our best to hold them outside, and had forced them to take cover. Then, a repulsortank moved in. I just knew we had had it at that point, but Vin put a thermal detonator through the arrogant tank commander's open hatch. He then proceeded to take out the remaining troops with a repeating blaster before they knew what hit them.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]]|<ref name="CRO-" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] '''ambushed''' the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Advisory Council (Alliance)|Advisory Council]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hythrope IV]]. They were rescued by former [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guard]] [[Vin Northal/Legends|Vin Northal]].<ref name="CRO-" />
